description: This header file declares the LEDControl class, which is a plugin component for the WPEFramework. It implements interfaces for plugin lifecycle management and JSONRPC communication, and provides methods related to controlling LED states.

classes.name: LEDControl
classes.description: A plugin class for controlling LEDs within the WPEFramework, supporting JSONRPC methods and plugin lifecycle management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell interface.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: setResponseArray
methods.description: Populates a JsonObject with an array of strings under a specified key.

methods.name: getSupportedLEDStates
methods.description: Retrieves the supported LED states based on input parameters.

methods.name: getLEDState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of an LED.

methods.name: setLEDState
methods.description: Sets the state of an LED.
